entries.original: The Prometheus planning-file guard resolves Windows paths the way the executor opens them: both `/` and `\` split the physical walk, so a `link/..` spelling is followed through the link instead of being collapsed lexically (a symlink escape was allowed), a symlinked or junctioned planning directory such as `.omo -> docs\plans` is recognised again, and 8.3 short names, drive-letter case and directory case all resolve to one canonical path. Inside-planning checks compare the canonical paths exactly, which keeps case-variant entries on case-sensitive directories distinct ([#11548](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11548))
entries.translated: Prometheus planning-file guard가 executor와 동일한 방식으로 Windows 경로를 해석합니다. `/`와 `\` 모두 물리적 경로 탐색을 분할하여 `link/..` 표기 시 어휘적 축소 대신 링크를 따라가도록 수정되었으며(심볼릭 링크 탈출 방지), `.omo -> docs\plans`와 같은 심볼릭 링크나 정션 디렉토리를 다시 인식합니다. 또한 8.3 짧은 이름과 대소문자 차이를 하나의 정규 경로(canonical path)로 통합하고, 내부 검사 시 이 경로를 정확히 비교하여 대소문자 구분 디렉토리 내의 항목들을 올바르게 식별합니다. ([#11548](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11548))

entries.original: A ChatGPT subscription whose sign-in refresh fails only briefly at session start (connection refused, timeout, a 408/429/5xx from the token endpoint) now stays selected in the model profile. Before, the session moved to the next provider, for example a configured OpenAI API key, and stayed on that metered lane until it was restarted. A refused refresh still skips the provider with the re-authenticate notice, a credential failure seen while re-checking the model still skips the provider with the matching notice, a model whose own request headers fail to resolve is still skipped, and a candidate kept while its refresh is still unresolved logs one warning with the error class and transport code so a later first-turn failure can be traced ([#11442](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11442), fixes [#11432](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11432)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525))
entries.translated: 세션 시작 시 로그인 갱신이 일시적으로 실패하더라도(연결 거부, 타임아웃, 408/429/5xx 에러 등) ChatGPT 구독 모델이 프로필에서 해제되지 않고 유지됩니다. 기존에는 세션이 다음 제공자(예: OpenAI API 키)로 전환되어 재시작 전까지 유료 API를 사용하던 문제가 있었습니다. 다만, 갱신 거부나 자격 증명 실패, 헤더 해석 오류 시에는 여전히 해당 제공자를 건너뛰며, 갱신 미해결 상태로 유지되는 경우 에러 로그를 남겨 추후 발생할 수 있는 실패의 추적을 돕습니다. ([#11442](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11442), [#11432](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11432) 수정) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525))

entries.original: `omo logout` now leaves a small sign-out note (no credentials, just the device and the time), so OmO Desktop can tell a deliberate sign-out from a credential store that hasn't answered yet. `omo account token` and `export` report it with exit code 10; exit 4 still means nothing could be read. Signing in again removes the note. The note is written before the credentials are removed, so a failed write leaves you signed in and `omo logout` reports the error; a damaged note is ignored (exit 4) and never breaks `omo account show`. ([#11441](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11441), fixes [#11434](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11434)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525))

([#11441](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11441), [#11434](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11434) 수정) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525))

entries.original: Prometheus checks and executes the same authorized planning-file path, including relative symlink/`..` paths, aliased project roots, hashline renames, and patch moves. Patch headers must round-trip through the supported executor parser without changing authorized operations or targets. Rename/delete preserve named final links; content writes follow only allowed targets. The physical planning directory may have any name the user chose (for example `.omo -> docs/plans`) but must be strictly inside the real project root, never the root itself or an ancestor; a `.omo` path segment matches with filesystem-native casing. Every denial is logged with its specific reason. Nested plans and parent-folder Windows paths remain supported; required argument rewrites fail closed if the host's retained arguments cannot receive them ([#11424](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11424))

entries.original: Research fidelity verification binds the unit written right after a value-only fact, with or without a space and with a Korean particle, a currency sign before it, its unit placeholder, or its table column header by visual column, so hand-edited units block and ordinary prose such as "m in total length" no longer raises a false unit mismatch. A scale word inside the value ("3,234억", "12 million") is part of the value, and a row header in a key/value table is never read as a column header. A qualifier after the value ("초과", "이상", "or more") or an ordinary word that is also a unit alias ("won awards", "second place") is never read as a unit; a unit wrapped in inline markup, in parentheses or after a line break is read; and fill records each value's bound unit, mode included, in the fill map, so an edit to an unknown unit, a deleted unit, or a deleted `data-fact-mode` attribute still blocks. The longest unit written after a value is the one checked, so a longer unit that starts with the row's unit ("12% 포인트", "12 percent points" for a row in %) blocks, and an ordinary unit word beside a currency sign of another currency ("$320 pounds") blocks. ([#11301](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11301))
